brief.title: Happy cartoon puppy figurine
brief.summary: A stylised puppy sitting up, with a big head tilted to one side, an open smiling mouth with its tongue out, floppy ears and a wagging tail. It is sculpted as one smooth blended (metaball) shape, then split into the three pieces it prints as: the body (with the collar's lower half and the tag), the head (with the collar's upper half) and the tail. The head is glued onto the body on a locating peg, the joint running round the middle of the collar; the tail plugs into a socket in the rump. Eyes, nose, mouth, tongue, ears, spots, cheek blush, toe lines and the collar with its tag are placed on the surface, so they follow it when parameters change, and merged into each part as faces of their own colour.

key_dimensions.name: Overall height
key_dimensions.note: top of head to bottom of paws; the whole model is scaled to this

key_dimensions.name: Length
key_dimensions.note: at 175 mm height, nose to tail tip

key_dimensions.name: Neck peg
key_dimensions.note: at 175 mm height: Ø × length, in a socket 0.3 mm larger

features: Sitting pose: front legs straight, hind legs folded with feet forward
Big head (head_scale) tilted sideways (head_tilt_deg) for a cheerful look
Open smiling mouth with the tongue out (mouth_open, tongue_length)
Shiny eyes with highlights, or closed happy ^ ^ eyes (eye_style), raised eyebrows
Floppy dark ears (ear_flare_deg) and a wagging tail (tail_wag_deg)
Eye patch and back spot, pink cheek blush, toe lines on all four paws
Red collar with a gold tag
Prints as three parts, glued together: body (with the neck peg and the tag), head (with the socket) and tail (standing on its flat root, which plugs into the rump)

Every detail prints at any height: raised lines, bumps, the ears, the tag and the neck band are at least 1 mm (two perimeters and a quarter) across; a line designed under half that is left out (the toe lines below about 33 mm tall)

Configurations cover the parameter extremes: no_collar, plain, small (30 mm), large_detailed (250 mm, fine mesh, a narrow mouth: nearer closed, its corners thin past the 0.8 mm wall), tilted_left and tilted_right
assumptions: Organic, sculpted shape: Blender metaballs give smooth blended forms that B-rep cannot
Each part is one solid whose details keep their own colours, for multi-colour printing (or print it in one colour)
FDM-printed on support: the body upright on its flat bottom, the head on its neck joint, the tail on its root; chin, tongue, ears and the tail's curl overhang
Parts are glued, with a 0.1 mm glue line at each joint
Bottom of the body is cut flat (about 1% of the height) so it stands steadily
The tag sits against the chest, just below the collar, held by a stub behind it
Without the collar, a soft fold of fur takes its place round the neck: the head's joint needs a band there to meet the neck squarely
The eye patch, spots and blush are raised 0.45 dog units (about 1 mm at 175 mm) and follow the surface
open_questions: Breed or colouring you have in mind (e.g. golden retriever, dalmatian, beagle)?
Pose: sitting (current), standing, or lying down?
Will it be 3D printed, and in one colour or several?

body.role: the sitting body and legs, with spots, toe lines, the collar's lower half, the tag and the neck peg; stands on its flat bottom

neck.description: the locating peg, from the neck joint up

tail.description: the bottom of the socket the tail plugs into

head.role: the head: face, ears, tongue and the collar's upper half; a socket takes the body's neck peg

neck.description: the socket that takes the peg, from the neck joint up

tail.role: the wagging tail with its cream tip, plugged into a socket in the rump

root.description: the tail's flat root face, which it prints standing on

requirements.text: As tall as the height parameter
Fits on a shelf: no wider than 0.7 and no deeper than 1.0 times its height
Looks happy and cute: smile, tongue out, wagging tail, tilted head
